output.reason: The only excerpts, [ev-782bc47d120d] and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2], show just "apiVersion: v1" from the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install.yaml. They don't show the CRD's storage flags, whether v1beta2 is still served, or any removal of v1beta2. So nothing in the evidence shows something failing or a step being mandatory in this release, and the "migration-required" (action-required) claim isn't supported. The change text itself says the rewrite is needed only "before a later release removes v1beta2", which reads like a deprecation rather than mandatory work now. To decide between migration-required and deprecation, the review needs the CRD excerpts showing the served and storage flags for v1beta2 and v1 in both releases, plus any upstream note on when v1beta2 is removed.
